latestVersion.changelog:
nimmit-onboarding 1.0.0

- Initial release of conversational onboarding for new Nimmit users via Telegram chat.
- Guides first-time users through organization setup, industry selection, language preference, team size, and top priorities—no technical steps required.
- Fully chat-based: never asks users to run commands or open a terminal.
- Handles edge cases such as users with existing setups and Khmer language support.
- Automates workspace file updates, skill pack installation, and daily morning briefing scheduling behind the scenes.
